title: Spatially exploring RNA biology in archival formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissues
highlights: Patho-DBiT enables spatial whole transcriptome sequencing in clinical FFPE tissues
Permits spatial co-profiling of gene expression, splicing, and non-coding RNAs
Genome-wide detection of spatial SNV distribution distinguishes malignant subclones
Dissects spatiotemporal dynamics of lymphomagenesis at the single-cell level
key_findings: Spatial profiling of multiple RNA species (mRNA, microRNA, tRNA, splicing isoforms) in FFPE tissues
High sensitivity and coverage for detecting RNA biology in archival clinical samples
Genome-wide mapping of single-nucleotide RNA variants to distinguish subclones
Dissection of spatiotemporal tumorigenesis at cellular level
experimental_models: Human AITL (angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma) FFPE tissue
Human MALT (mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue) lymphoma FFPE tissue
